resources.string: Automatic adapts to the mode reported by the car. If undetected, select Full screen or Split screen here. Full screen enlarges the chart; the glucose card keeps its size. Changes apply immediately.
Glucose screen through an AAIdrive addon
Shows glucose, trend, delta and a three-hour chart in Material 3 cards. Uses your selected unit and target range, with phone or watch readings.
Install AAIdrive to use this addon.
Waiting for AAIdrive to connect to the car
Waiting for BMW/MINI security access. Check the connection apps used by AAIdrive.
AAIdrive resources unavailable. Use the official AAIdrive release and reconnect the phone.
Connection interrupted or authentication failed. Retrying automatically.

1. Enable the dedicated screen here.
2. Open AAIdrive and check for LibreCRDroid under Addons.
3. Connect the phone to BMW through Connected Apps. Reconnect if it was already connected during installation.
4. LibreCR · Glucose opens automatically after connecting. You can reopen it from the car’s Connected Apps / ConnectedDrive menu.

Experimental integration for NBT/NBT Evo. Requires installed AAIdrive and its working BMW/MINI connection. Readings are hidden after six minutes. The screen occupies its own iDrive page. Keep phone or watch glucose alarms enabled.
